يلتحموا (form VIII)
# يَلْتَحِمُوا (yaltaḥimū) /jal.ta.ħi.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# يُلْتَحَمُوا (yultaḥamū) /jul.ta.ħa.muː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
